headline: Paraguay's Ueno Bank Intervened After Financial Irregularities
summary: The intervention of Paraguay's Ueno Bank following severe financial irregularities triggered a political and financial crisis, with eight executives detained and depositors awaiting funds.
why: Banking sector stability is critical for emerging market economies, and regulatory interventions can disrupt domestic credit conditions and investor confidence.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Banking system scandals create macro instability and impair local investment reputation.
